# Contribute to MTWebsite

Personal portfolio site for [matthewgtran.com](https://matthewgtran.com).

1. [Fork][fork] and clone the repository.
1. Create a new branch from `main`: `git checkout -b <my-branch-name>`
1. Make your changes, and make sure the site still builds (`npm run build` or `npm run check`).
1. Push to your fork and [submit a pull request][compare] from your branch to `main`.
1. Keep your change as focused as possible. If there are multiple independent changes, consider separate pull requests.

Content updates usually belong in `src/data/`, `src/content/projects/`, or `src/pages/` — see [`docs/CONTENT-GUIDE.md`](../docs/CONTENT-GUIDE.md).

[fork]: https://github.com/SypherXN/MTWebsite/fork
[compare]: https://github.com/SypherXN/MTWebsite/compare
